title: Separate CDK bootstrap qualifier per environment
description:
As the owner, I want development, staging and production to use separate CDK bootstrap qualifiers, so that peer-environment denies on the OIDC deploy roles are real isolation.

All three roles share one set of CDK bootstrap roles whose CloudFormation execution role is AdministratorAccess, so today the denies bound only the OIDC roles (chatticus-e49160).

Feature: Per-environment bootstrap isolation
  Scenario: A development deploy cannot act as production
    Given each environment has its own CDK bootstrap qualifier and execution role
    When the development deploy role tries to assume the production bootstrap roles
    Then the request is denied
    And the development deploy workflows stay green
